label: Dashboard Data
summary: Quiet operational frames for KPI snapshots, trend reviews, and status-heavy monitoring scenes.
description: Original Lucida dashboard family for real structured metrics with dense but orderly panels, chart hierarchy, semantic states, and explicit empty/loading/error behavior.
avoidFor: story-led cinematic hooks without structured data
product-first showcase scenes where media is the subject
freeform collage scenes without explicit metric ownership
layoutGrammar: Keep panel count fixed and use one sibling panel per responsibility.
Use semantic state colors only to clarify meaning, never as decorative fills.
Render KPI, chart, and operations surfaces from explicit fixture fields only.
When data is missing, keep the panel structure and show loading, empty, or error state copy instead of inventing values.
Do not nest cards inside panels; use rules, columns, and row separators for density.

sourcePolicy.notes: The package uses original Lucida layout decisions, fixture copy, and shared core primitives only. No third-party logos, screenshots, or copied UI assets are registered.

notes: Rendered through a standalone family composition because shared registry and app root integrations are outside this ownership scope.
Edge fixtures explicitly validate loading, empty, and error handling without phantom data.
